dispatch.reason: vLLM 0.26.0 already dispatches backend_per_kind before Attention construction and the model runner creates distinct backend/spec/head metadata groups.

prefill.production_batch: c32 with 4,214 prompt tokens/request; 134,848 aggregate prompt tokens are chunked by max_num_batched_tokens=65,536
prefill.scheduler_tensor_extent: T <= 65,536 new tokens per scheduler step
prefill.sliding_output: [T,32,256] BF16 then flattened to [T,8192] for o_proj
prefill.full_k_v: [T,4,512] BF16 each; attention_k_eq_v makes the producer values equal while retaining separate packed K/V slots
prefill.full_output: [T,32,512] BF16 then flattened to [T,16384] for o_proj

decode.production_batch: T=32 new tokens per c32 decode step
decode.sliding_context: at most 1,024 logical KV positions per request
decode.full_context: up to 4,572 positions for the 4,214+358 exact request mix, bounded by max_model_len=5,000
decode.slot_ownership: the scheduler slot_mapping writes K/V for each layer; num_kv_shared_layers=0, so every one of the 60 layers owns its own cache
decode.gqa: local 32Q:16KV (2 queries/KV head); global 32Q:4KV (8 queries/KV head)

mask_semantics.sliding_window: (causal OR same multimodal-prefix block) AND 1,024-token window; retained on Triton because it consumes mm_prefix_clamp_sliding_window
mask_semantics.full_attention: causal OR same multimodal-prefix block; FlexAttention implements this exact global-layer mask with no window term
mask_semantics.invalid_split_rejected: FLEX_ATTENTION was not assigned to sliding layers because vLLM 0.26.0 composes its generic prefix term outside the sliding-window AND and does not consume Gemma4's clamp flag

kv_layout.compatibility: TritonAttentionBackend and FlexAttentionBackend both expose layered stride order (1,0,3,2,4), so the split does not relayout or transfer KV

FLASH_ATTN.evidence: Gemma4 sets use_mm_prefix for all decoder layers. vLLM requires FA4 for that contract; its selector only prefers FA4 for capability major 10, and the FA4 Blackwell TMEM guard falls back above head_size 128 except 192. Local 256 and global 512 therefore cannot be exact FA4 consumers on sm_120.

FLASHINFER.evidence: The backend supports head sizes 256/512 and capability through 12.1 but does not advertise supports_mm_prefix, so startup validation rejects it.

FLEX_ATTENTION_sliding.evidence: Its v0.26.0 generic mask composes (causal AND sliding_window) OR mm_prefix, whereas Gemma4 sliding layers require (causal OR mm_prefix) AND sliding_window.

FLEX_ATTENTION_full.evidence: The full layers have no sliding term, attn_logit_softcapping is null, num_kv_shared_layers is zero, BF16 KV is supported, GQA is enabled, and the multimodal prefix is ORed with the causal mask.

physical_hypothesis.causal_change: Move ten 512-wide full-attention layers from Triton's unified attention implementation to the FlexAttention block-mask consumer while retaining all fifty local layers and their exact clamp semantics on Triton.
physical_hypothesis.predicted_change: The global group no longer allocates or enters Triton's 16-segment softmax scratch/reduction family; the decisive future metric is lower non-overlapping full-layer attention kernel time at c32. No KV-byte reduction or endpoint gain is claimed offline.
physical_hypothesis.falsifier: Reject the split if the exact sm_120 oracle differs in any prompt/output token row or if profiler-off median full-layer attention time is not lower than the all-Triton control outside run noise.

coverage: exact pinned geometry admits the split

build.reason: The candidate uses the stock vLLM 0.26.0 backend_per_kind contract and official backend implementations; no runtime source bytes change.

future_sm120_oracle.oracle_contract: Two fresh model processes run all-Triton control and layer-aware candidate on sm_120, hash-bind the wheel, assert exact vLLM/Torch/device identities, require startup-log proof for both candidate backends, and compare prompt IDs plus greedy output IDs/text exactly for two text requests and one deterministic multimodal-prefix request.
future_sm120_oracle.measurement_after_oracle: Only after the norm-FP8 itinerary resolves and the director grants a future bench handoff, add the cli_fragment to the otherwise identical c32 endpoint and compare profiler-off request time plus non-overlapping full-layer attention kernel time.
